description: Implementation of a 32-bit Murmur3 hash function for use within Apache Spark, based on Guava's Murmur3_32HashFunction. Contains methods for hashing integers, long values, and byte arrays with considerations for endianness and backward compatibility.
external_files: Platform (assumed to be a class providing getByte and getInt methods)

classes.name: Murmur3_x86_32
classes.description: Final class implementing a Murmur3 32-bit hash function with methods for hashing integers, long values, and byte arrays, considering endianness and supporting backward compatibility.

methods.name: hashInt
methods.description: Hashes an integer input with the instance's seed.

methods.name: hashUnsafeWords
methods.description: Hashes byte data aligned to 8-byte words, based on Guava's processRemaining method.

methods.name: hashUnsafeBytes
methods.description: Hashes byte data with potential unaligned tail, not compatible with original implementations, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: hashUnsafeBytes2
methods.description: Hashes byte data with tail, compatible with original implementations, used for new components after Spark 2.3.

methods.name: hashLong
methods.description: Hashes a long value with the instance's seed.
